name: sim_gudhi_capability
purpose: tool-capability isolation probe for GUDHI persistent homology
operation_sequence: construct a finite jittered circle point cloud and build a GUDHI Rips complex
compute persistence and count persistent H0/H1 features from the Rips diagram
build a GUDHI AlphaComplex on the same point cloud and compare H0/H1 counts
extract H1 barcode intervals and query persistent Betti numbers at a midpoint filtration
compare GUDHI H0 alive-at-epsilon against a numpy connected-components baseline
run random-noise, empty-cloud, single-point, and duplicate-point controls
carrier_topology: finite point-cloud and SimplexTree persistent-homology fixture; no topology lego promotion, manifold admission, bridge, axis, GStack, QIT engine, or nonclassical claim
observable: persistent H0/H1 counts, H1 barcode interval count and lifetime, persistent Betti vector at a declared filtration, numpy connected component agreement, and degenerate input behavior
pass_fail_predicate: pass iff circle Rips and Alpha complexes expose one persistent H0 and one persistent H1 feature, barcode and Betti APIs agree at the probe filtration, numpy and GUDHI H0 counts match on separated clusters, noise has no robust H1, and degenerate boundaries behave as declared
graveyards: random noise cloud must not expose a robust H1 feature at the declared threshold
empty point cloud must not fabricate persistence features
single point must document GUDHI's empty-diagram capability limit
duplicate points must collapse to one connected component
numpy connected-components baseline must agree with GUDHI H0 alive-at-epsilon
baselines: numpy connected-components count on an epsilon graph
AlphaComplex on the same circle cloud as an alternate GUDHI construction
random Gaussian point cloud as a no-robust-cycle counterfactual
empty, singleton, and duplicate-point degenerate controls
alternative_formulations: manual SimplexTree insertion for a declared filtered complex
Rips filtration over a square or annulus fixture
persistence diagram stability sweep under small point-cloud perturbations
tool_function_needs: SimplexTree.insert and num_vertices for degenerate controls
lego_coupling_target: bounded GUDHI persistent-homology capability evidence before exact topology lego-fit or coupling packets
claim_ceiling: finite sim_gudhi_capability tool-capability receipt only; no bridge, GStack, axis, QIT, or nonclassical admission
